conclusion.evidence_boundary: This is one deterministic virtual recovery-mechanics comparison. Held-out learning quality and the complete six-policy baseline vector remain unresolved.
conclusion.plain_answer: The adaptive policy reached the same durable frontier with lower mechanical completion time and fewer inter-site link bytes on this trace.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: No fixed baseline may match the adaptive policy across the complete preregistered primary vector within uncertainty.
evidence_requirements.description: Adaptive control must beat every fixed baseline on the complete primary outcome vector rather than one favorable scalar.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: All learning metrics must satisfy their preregistered bounds on held-out runs with calibrated interval coverage.
evidence_requirements.description: Learning progress, quality risk, and time-to-target must transfer from calibration runs to held-out multi-site training.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: A virtual prior or 360M one-step-delay paper cannot resolve this.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: Deferred and replayed work must not reverse the claimed benefit.
evidence_requirements.description: The result must survive full time, energy, recovery, and cost accounting rather than shifting work outside the window.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: Requires metered facility energy and complete recovery accounting.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: Every mechanism in the hypothesis must be executable or the run must remain an explicitly partial mechanics screen.
evidence_requirements.description: The tested policy must expose cadence, topology, pipeline delay, optimizer correction, parallelism, placement, and membership.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: The current E001 runner implements cadence only.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: Every named comparator executes; adaptive-recovery remains the candidate, and no omitted comparator can support a superiority claim.
evidence_requirements.description: Every recovery comparator and the parent centralized and sparse-gossip obligations must execute on matched traces.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: Recovery-v2 completion does not waive centralized-equivalent or fixed-sparse-gossip parent-protocol obligations.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: All named panels must be present before a transfer conclusion.
evidence_requirements.description: The confirmatory evidence must span every frozen transfer panel.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: Virtual scenario coverage is not a held-out panel.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: Unique link-segment accounting, preemption, rollback, restore, replay, membership, and debt panels must all pass before traffic or interruption metrics support E001.
evidence_requirements.description: Traffic and interruption claims require algorithm-specific collective bytes plus preemption, lost-work, and recovery semantics.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: Payload-only bytes, additive overlapping categories, or whole-operation postponement are insufficient.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: Each nonempty material timestamp batch produces exactly one content-addressed decision state containing every transition in canonical order; candidate-visible state changes only after observation.
evidence_requirements.description: Physical occurrence and controller observation remain distinct for failure and recovery, with immutable checkpoint, restore, and re-entry epochs.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: A trace that postpones whole operations or exposes physical truth before controller observation fails this gate.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: Candidate decisions and visible-state serializations are byte-identical through identical observable prefixes; effective execution membership contains only physically healthy, state-ready sites.
evidence_requirements.description: Candidate membership decisions use only controller-observed state while engine-private physical state safely constrains execution.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: Oracle trace access, scenario closure access, private physical-state leakage, or queued future metadata fails this gate.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: Attempted compute equals valid-final-state plus lost compute; replay is a labeled subset; attempted collective link bytes equal completed plus aborted disjoint segments; every executed portion is invalidated at most once.
evidence_requirements.description: Every executed compute portion and physical link segment has one terminal disposition without double counting across rollback and replay.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: Scheduled totals without executed portions, final validity, and terminal attempt dispositions cannot satisfy this gate.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: A restore references one complete content-addressed manifest; exact shard bytes and hashes reconstruct its declared state, and same-time storage failure is applied after commit but can still destroy a non-surviving shard.
evidence_requirements.description: Only atomic manifests with exact shards and model, optimizer, RNG, data, membership, and failure-domain lineage may restore state.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: Checkpoint byte counts or partial shard writes without a surviving atomic manifest are not recovery evidence.
required_panels: restored model optimizer RNG and data lineage

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: Every recovery comparator executes on the same absolute-time trace and terminal durable-frontier target; adaptive-recovery is labeled candidate.
evidence_requirements.description: All six recovery policies execute on matched absolute-time traces, checkpoint triggers, state sizes, seeds, sample order, and accounting.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: The future-trace policy is an oracle comparator only. Policy-decision regret remains unresolved until a scalar objective is separately frozen.

falsifiers.description: Less than 95% centralized progress per FLOP falsifies E001.
More than 10% of the matched synchronous recovery baseline's unique physical inter-site link bytes fails the preregistered 10x reduction.

protocol.hypothesis: Adaptive consistency, communication topology, parallelism, and site membership retain at least 95% of centralized loss progress per FLOP, use at least 10 times fewer inter-site bytes than synchronous global all-reduce, and finish sooner under site interruptions.

notes: The virtual datacenter can screen but cannot validate convergence.
Learning response must be calibrated from separate observations.
The focused recovery-v2 runner executes four matched policies; the full six-policy comparator obligation remains unresolved.
Checkpoint triggers are matched absolute wall-clock times; actual atomic commit times are serialized separately.
Every physical link-direction segment has one traffic class; retransmissions retain their class and attempt id.
Attempted collective link bytes equal completed plus aborted collective link bytes and are not an additional traffic class.
Checkpoint-write diagnostics cover local and remote physical I/O; partial writes are a subset, while remote replication remains the only additive inter-site checkpoint-write traffic class.
Recovery debt uses one serialized shared durable-frontier target and an actual post-failure anchor.
Overlapping or repeated causal failures form one joint recovery episode unless a separate marginal estimand is preregistered.
Policy-decision regret is not a recovery mechanics result until its scalar objective is preregistered.
